title: migrate-shell-build-steps-to-ts-action-and-add-dep-provenance
author: Aisha Kline
release_notes: Operational: CI build steps migrated from ad-hoc shell scripts to a typed TypeScript composite action and dependency provenance recording added; no API changes.
body: Context: Our repository still runs a number of ad-hoc shell build steps in CI that are hard to lint, test, and reason about. These scripts are the primary source of occasional flakiness in cross-platform runners and make dependency updates riskier because provenance metadata is not recorded. Motivation: Move build orchestration into a TypeScript composite GitHub Action so steps are typed, tested, and easier to debug; at the same time record dependency provenance (package manager, lockfile hash, container base image) to aid post-incident forensics and to provide an audit trail for Dedicated/Private customers. What this PR does: 1) Introduces actions/ts-build-composite, a lightweight TypeScript composite action that wraps the previous shell steps (install, generate-bindings, build, sanity-check). 2) Replaces inline shell usage in .github/workflows/ci.yml with the new action. 3) Adds a provenance reporter that emits a small JSON artifact to the run artifacts and logs a compact provenance line to the job log for quick glanceability. 4) Pins a small set of development dependencies and adds an audit script that runs in CI to remind engineers to stamp dependency updates to a provenance file. Checklist: [x] Compile and unit-test the TS action locally with act; [x] Add integration CI job to exercise the composite action in Umbrella repo; [x] Update developer docs (CONTRIBUTING.md) with how to run/iterate on the action; [x] Add a short-note release entry in internal changelog. Testing performed: local act runs, CI runs across ubuntu-latest and macos-latest (linux and mac runners exercised), added unit tests for the provenance reporter, manual validation of artifact contents. Rollout plan: merge to main, watch ci-build job for 48h; if any regression, feature flagging via using old shell action in a hotfix branch is possible. Risks and mitigations: The TS action adds node as a runtime in the runner; we ensured the action runs with node12+ compatibility shim and kept the action minimal to avoid heavy install overhead. For customers with strict compliance, provenance recording is opt-out via REPO_CI_PROVENANCE=false. Related: ENG-12743 (CI stability initiative), ENG-12760 (dep-provenance epics), SUP-412 (customer incident that motivated stronger provenance).
